gaps.sentence: They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.

gaps.sentence: The ministry tried to play ___ the incident.
gaps.explanation: play down = make something seem less important (opposite: play up).

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
Could you look ___ my suitcase while I buy the tickets?
gaps.explanation: look after = take care of; look for = search; look up = check in a reference.

gaps.sentence: I've mixed ___ the twins' names again.
gaps.explanation: mix up = confuse one thing/person with another.

gaps.sentence: The match was called ___ because of the storm.
These old boots are completely worn ___.
gaps.explanation: wear out = become thin/unusable through use.
